weaknesses.title: WHERE match is equality only — no retries>=N / compound predicates
weaknesses.detail: Cannot escalate only jobs with retries>=3 via SETFWHERE. Agents must GETFWHERE+EACH or WHEREGE-style siblings if any; SETFWHERE status retry→dead kills all retries regardless of count.
weaknesses.repro: SETFWHERE Job status retry status dead hits retries=1 and retries=99

weaknesses.title: INCFWHERE after status rewrite double-bumps cohort
weaknesses.detail: If fail does SETFWHERE running→retry then INCFWHERE status retry, every already-retry job also increments. Bump-then-rewrite order is mandatory and undocumented as footgun.
weaknesses.repro: old retry=2; new fail path; wrong order → old becomes 3

weaknesses.title: No multi-field WHERE update — requeue cannot zero retries
weaknesses.detail: SETFWHERE dead→pending leaves retries sticky. Need second SETFWHERE or SETFALL retries 0 (unscoped) or per-slot SETF.

weaknesses.title: NOBJS stale until LISTOBJS
weaknesses.detail: Same as iter 127: admit-all needs LISTOBJS before NOBJS or silent deny.

weaknesses.title: GETFWHERE bag is values only unless AS KV
weaknesses.detail: Default collect loses object identity; AS KV uses object name not FIELD id. Agents needing id:retries must AS KV or GETFALL id separately.
weaknesses.repro: GETFWHERE retries status retry → 1\n1; AS KV → j0:1

weaknesses.title: Missing set field soft SKIP; no-match N=0 looks like success unless checked
weaknesses.detail: SETFWHERE_N==0 and SETFWHERE_SKIP must be agent-checked; OK path still continues.
weaknesses.repro: probe missing status N=0; bad field SKIP=3

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH first-only; non-numeric REQUIRE softens
weaknesses.detail: Two j0:fail → one SETMATCH; REQUIRE=abc → soft.
